scope: Synthetic wrapped first-selection screening only; full workflow completion, ordinary unwrapped routing, and savings unmeasured.

protocol.pair_order: A/B when (zero_based_case_index + zero_based_repetition) even; B/A otherwise
protocol.scope: initial skill selection; workflow completion untested
protocol.wrapper: This is a read-only initial skill selection probe. Do not perform the requested workflow, write files, run scripts or call external tools. Choose and load only the first applicable skill using the Skill tool, then stop and return its name. If no skill applies, return NONE. Task:

supplemental_command_source_checks.scope: Supplemental source verification; original scoring and expectations unchanged. Strip YAML and empty $ARGUMENTS only.

limits: Command routes without a SKILL.md base-directory event are selected-source-unverified in this frozen observer. They are unavailable scoring evidence, not proven workflow failures.
A no-selection output other than the explicit NONE marker is unverified, never a correct negative.
Claude does not expose resolved effort in this stream. Requested low is identical; resolved effort remains null.
Token and elapsed counters are raw observations; invalid or mismatched rows cannot establish efficiency. No savings or selection-improvement claim is made.

codex_explicit_load_readiness.scope: Explicit file-load readiness only: three explicit cases x three repetitions x two arms. Full 19-case Codex selection cohort not run because Claude adoption screen already failed.
codex_explicit_load_readiness.resolved_identity_limit: CLI events do not report per-run resolved identity; separate native app-server preflight confirmed requested settings, not generation identity.
codex_explicit_load_readiness.catalog_override: Only the three installed duplicate candidate paths were disabled in these ephemeral test processes, replaced by corresponding arm snapshots; all other skills retained and no persistent configuration or installed source changed.
